DIAGNOSIS READY: Parkinson's Disease

The clinical picture of a unilateral resting tremor that has progressed to affect the contralateral side, combined with soft speech (hypophonia), reduced facial expressions (masked facies), and executive dysfunction (financial management issues), is highly suggestive of Parkinson's Disease.
